`final class RoundedShader`<br/>
**Extends:** [`ShaderProgram`](/reference/shaders/shaderprogram/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.shader.impl` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [RoundedShader.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/shader/impl/RoundedShader.java)

The shader of rounded rectangles and rounded borders, which masks what is drawn outside a rounded box.

## Description

[`DrawShape`](/reference/drawing/drawshape/) and [`RoundedShaderPass`](/reference/shaders/roundedshaderpass/) use it; call it for geometry of your own that needs rounded corners.
The box is given as its inner rectangle, the box shrunk by the radius on each rounded side, in the coordinates you draw in.

### use

`void use(float radius, float x1, float y1, float x2, float y2, Runnable runnable)` <span class="joid-qualifier">static</span>

### bind

`void bind(float radius, float x1, float y1, float x2, float y2)`

`void bind(float radius, float x1, float y1, float x2, float y2, ShaderFillType type)`

<a id="RoundedShader-method-aligned"></a>

### aligned

`void aligned(boolean aligned)` 

If `true`, the edge is smoothed over one screen pixel for a box on the pixel grid; if `false`, over the coverage of a box under a rotation or a fractional scale.

<a id="RoundedShader-method-stroke"></a>

### stroke

`void stroke(float stroke)` 

Keeps only a stroke `stroke` wide inside the edge, for a rounded border; `0F` fills the whole box.
